caption: The drawing depicts a woven textile, possibly a small rug or blanket, with a diagonal striped pattern consisting of brown, red, and beige threads. The textile is rectangular, and one edge is folded over, revealing the same pattern on both sides, but with vertical orientation on the folded section. The rightmost edge is bordered with a thick twisted cord in blue, red, and brown colors. The bottom edge of the textile features loose, short fringes of the same colors found in the main pattern. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with slight stains and shadows cast by the textile, suggesting it is lying flat.
title: Shaker Material
